Priy Study launches Sigma Study through standard Android intents to its normal Home Screen. It respects official logins, activation codes, ads, and access controls, and never shares authentication tokens.
Configure and verify your Sigma Study package ID, optional deep link, official website, and HTTPS URL shortener.
How to Verify Sigma Study Package ID

1. Open Sigma Study on Google Play and tap Share → Copy Link. The package name is the value after ?id=.\n2. Or connect via USB and run: adb shell pm list packages | grep -i sigma\n3. Only enter HTTPS URLs you own or have verified.
